I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 12515 Country: India Title: As-Salamu-Alequm, I saw a dream before Fazr?s Namaaz last week. I saw that I am in a desert with a man wearing white cloths whose face was very Noorany & pleasant. He told the same word which was used by Huzoor S.A.W. in his last Khutba. He told me that Follow the way which I show to you then nobody will damage or harm you in any way. On that night, I had very high fever with shivering for whole night. I am frequently & regularly recite Darood Sharif. I am also regularly recite Dua-E-Ganjul Arsh. My Mother Name is Raisa Begum. Please provide your valuable advice. Allah Hafiz! Question: As-Salamu-Alequm, I saw a dream before Fazr?s Namaaz last week. I saw that I am in a desert with a man wearing white cloths whose face was very Noorany & pleasant. He told the same word which was used by Huzoor S.A.W. in his last Khutba. He told me that Follow the way which I show to you then nobody will damage or harm you in any way. On that night, I had very high fever with shivering for whole night. I am frequently & regularly recite Darood Sharif. I am also regularly recite Dua-E-Ganjul Arsh. My Mother Name is Raisa Begum. Please provide your valuable advice. Allah Hafiz! Answer ID: 12515 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1054/825=H/1430) The dream indicates that you should follow the sunnah. This is the interpretation of your dream. Leave reciting the Dau-e-Ganjul Arsh. And which durood you recite? Write it down and submit the question again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
